code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active=[any(v!=bg for v in row) for row in g]
    r=0
    while r<h:
        if not active[r]:
            r+=1; continue
        a=r
        while r<h and active[r]:
            r+=1
        b=r
        endpoints={y:max((x for x,v in enumerate(g[y]) if v!=bg), default=-1) for y in range(a,b)}
        right=max(endpoints.values())
        for y,end in endpoints.items():
            if end==right:
                for x in range(right+1,w):
                    g[y][x]=1
    return g
'''
